الحُرَّةُ : see حُرٌّ. ―
-b2- حُرَّةُ الذِّفْرَى (tropical:) The part of the protuberance behind the ear where the earring swings about: (S, K: *) or it is an epithet, signifying beautiful and smooth and long in the protuberance behind the ear; applied to a woman and to a she-camel. (TA.) ―
-b3- الحُرَّتَانِ is also said to signify The two ears. (TA.) One says, حَفِظَ ٱللّٰهُ كَرِيمَتَيْكَ وَحُرَّتَيْكَ (A, TA) i. e. (tropical:) [May God preserve thy two eyes and] thy two ears. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Chamomile, or chamomile-flowers; syn. البَابُونَجُ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
